guide.text: Increases Spiritual Amplification and has a chance to reduce enemy healing. Black Adam deals more damage to low-HP targets, and the healing reduction gives them less room to recover, making his finishing blow more reliable.

Grants Energy Gain Bonus, allowing Constantine to reach his power spike earlier, while also increasing Spiritual AMP and granting a chance to apply healing reduction. With his Ultimate's scaling damage, Constantine deals devastating AoE damage as the battle progresses.
Increases Spiritual Amplification. After casting the Ultimate, there is a chance to inflict [Severe Wound] on the targets, reducing healing received.
